statement: The fact and evidence layers are deliverable. Applicant eligibility is not determined and cannot be, from public sources alone.

hard_problems.why: The agency uses an in-house category such as 经济金融类 or 气象类. Its 2027 pages were checked and no applicable membership list was found. Not-found is not does-not-exist, so the positions stay unresolved.
In-house category phrase, but whether the agency publishes a list was not verified.
Colloquial 类 suffixes, cross-level vocabulary and open phrases such as 相关专业. Group audit found zero exact in-scope names that the matcher missed, so there is no parser defect left to fix.
Covered only by the 门类 reading, whose cited statement applies to MOE positions. Exact characters and gate nodes are recorded; agency applicability is not.

A printed name belongs to a different code. The source text itself is inconsistent; the data records the span and both names rather than picking a winner. Position and entry counts are distinct: one position can carry several entries.
Same code naming something else at another level, or a dropped 类 suffix. This is a reading of the text, not a source error.
备注 mixes levels in one label (本科或研究生阶段). The code falls back to the position scope and is flagged; it was deliberately not widened.

autonomously_fixable_scope: 在本次已审计范围内（19,426 岗的逐岗证据、残留分层、冲突语族、备注作用域），未发现可自主修复项；这不是“全世界不存在进一步问题”的证明。
external_blockers: No applicable 2027 membership list found for the PBOC 经济金融类 or CMA 气象类 categories.
Some 备注 sentences mix degree levels without a clean label and need a human reading.
Semantic conflicts inside the source text need the recruiting agency to clarify.
not_delivered: 一张 2027 全国统一专业成员表：截至 2026-10-18 的已查公开来源未找到，不能据此断言不存在。
2027 interview cutoffs (they do not exist before the written exam).
review_caveat: 5,835 is the legacy review denominator, not an uncovered count. 995 of them no longer reproduce a warning under the current catalogs; that is a statement about the tool, not a cleared position. Buckets are mutually exclusive but a position can carry several risk markers.
